items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
ONI, Cycle 1; three duplicants (Ashkan and Bubbles identified). Starting food was 16,000 kcal; latest full Resources view still showed 16,000 kcal Nutrient Bars. Oxygen-generator warning remains. The left water reservoir is still sealed and must not be breached.

Observed excavation/navigation: G activates Dig. The initial small right-side excavation completed, but the larger far-right orders were later explicitly labeled “Unreachable Dig”; duplicants were idle during a Work shift, not on a scheduled break. Ashkan’s details confirmed Idle/no upcoming errands. A drag intended to mark the connecting wall instead covered already-excavated empty space and added no orders. Do not keep ordering isolated tiles across inaccessible gaps. One reachable sandstone tile immediately left of Bubbles (about .324,.493) was then marked; Bubbles excavated it successfully without opening the reservoir. It yielded 920 kg Sandstone, which became available for construction.

Outhouse: costs 200 kg Raw Mineral or Wood, needs no piping, uses dirt, and requires periodic emptying. Early placement failed with zero suitable material. After mining, Plumbing (bottom about .172,.933) > Outhouse (about .098,.765) opened a material-selection step; 920 kg Sandstone was shown. Clicking the panel area to the right did not select it, but clicking the Sandstone material icon (about .216,.572) did. A valid ghost was placed once on the starting room’s right-hand floor (about .594,.510). Escape exited placement mode, preventing duplicate orders. Available Sandstone dropped to 720 kg. Ashkan delivered the full 200 kg, and the Outhouse is now visibly under construction with duplicants working and progress nearly complete in later views; completion has not yet been observed. Its alert may remain while unfinished.

Oxygen: Oxygen menu is bottom-left about .062,.933; its only shown building is Oxygen Diffuser (about .043,.771). Observed requirements: 200 kg Metal Ore, 120 W power, and 550 g/s Algae to produce Oxygen. No Metal Ore is stored, and no diffuser or power source has been built. Full Resources listed 720 kg Sandstone after the Outhouse reservation and no Metal Ore. Confirmed nearby deposits: 188.8 kg Algae in the solid wall above the starting room/reservoir area (about .276,.318), and 191 kg Algae below the left starting-room floor (about .425,.614). The tile above the printing pod (.533,.303) and the tile beneath the room (.474,.675) were inspected and are Sandstone, not Metal Ore. The final action hovered a copper-colored speckled deposit high above/right of the base (.661,.084) to identify it, but no resulting tooltip was observed; whether it is Metal Ore or reachable remains unknown.

Controls/lessons: Space toggles pause but its effect was ambiguous; Tab changes speed. Normal Play is about .110,.078 and fastest about .139–.146,.076. Short waits at running speed allowed excavation, delivery, and construction to advance. Escape dismisses tools/placement. Build menus may close without placement until a construction material is explicitly selected. Early repeated waits/speed changes and reopening build UI did not fix idleness; the confirmed cause for the outstanding digs was unreachability, not missing dig commands. Mined sandstone did become usable, so the earlier hypothesis that loose drops necessarily required a separate collection step is unsupported.

Active goals: allow the single Outhouse to finish and verify its warning clears; identify and safely excavate a reachable source of at least 200 kg Metal Ore; then place an Oxygen Diffuser and arrange its required 120 W power and Algae supply. Continue avoiding excavation that could breach the left reservoir.
